boundary: Prepared complete geometry consumer. Original numerical kernel, ranks, seeds, stages and all-rate aggregation are retained. Exact entry counts use the separate accepted amendment. Unsupported nonzero subspace signal rank is refused, not imputed. This does not release training or certify retrieval mechanisms/dimension utility; draft-parent release transition and downstream consumers remain required.

subspace_validity.boundary_gap: Retain the projected relative gap at the retained boundary descriptively; no post-hoc gap threshold, rank choice or optimizer support rule
subspace_validity.entry_fraction: Use the separate exact-entry amendment; preserve the original matrix-mass proxy under its explicit different name
subspace_validity.nonzero_signal_rank: Require every retained singular value above float32 epsilon * max(matrix dimensions) * projected leading singular value; refuse unsupported rank rather than adding null directions or dropping that matrix
subspace_validity.partial_spectrum: Entropy effective rank is computed from the top-64 sketch, not the full singular spectrum or useful embedding dimensions; always retain captured energy
subspace_validity.readback: Recompute all raw metrics and singular bases from the same saved weights with the declared CPU thread count; exact same-runtime equality, not a cross-host bitwise guarantee
subspace_validity.zero: Exactly zero saved displacement has undefined subspace; exclude only those matrices and report defined parameter mass

weight_space_rules.cumulative_definition: Checkpoint weight minus the pinned pretrained initialization.
per_checkpoint_metrics: saved-segment Frobenius norm and segment-to-weight ratio
cumulative displacement Frobenius norm and displacement-to-weight ratio
parameter-weighted stable rank and stable-rank fraction
parameter-weighted top-64 sketch entropy effective rank and rank fraction
row-norm coefficient of variation and top-1-percent row energy
fraction of hidden parameters with nonzero saved displacement after checkpoint serialization
weight_space_rules.rate_pair_policy: Compute all unordered run pairs. For optimizer-pair summaries, average all available learning-rate pairs equally without BEIR or validation selection.
weight_space_rules.saved_segment_definition: At stage 1, checkpoint weight minus the pinned pretrained initialization. At stages 2-5, current checkpoint weight minus the preceding retained checkpoint weight.
weight_space_rules.scope: The 88 hidden two-dimensional matrices routed to the main optimizer; auxiliary embeddings, pooling, norms, and biases are excluded from the headline geometry.
weight_space_rules.subspace_metric: For every unordered run pair at the same stage and displacement kind, compute rank-16 randomized left and right singular bases per hidden matrix. Normalize squared Frobenius canonical overlap by retained rank, average left and right, then parameter-weight across tensors for which both displacements are nonzero.
weight_space_rules.terminology_boundary: Saved-segment displacement is a coarse parameter displacement over many optimizer steps. It is not an instantaneous update, the sum of per-step update norms, or optimizer path length.
weight_space_rules.zero_displacement_rule: A matrix with exactly zero serialized displacement has undefined singular subspace. Exclude it from overlap numerators and denominators and report the defined-parameter fraction; never impute zero or one overlap.
